key_idea: Merge the two voices' syllables of each line by start time and assign columns greedily: a column is the max of (previous event column + time gap) and (end of the previous syllable in each voice singing now + 1).
sketch: Compute absolute start times of every syllable; voice 2 is the same list shifted by D, and for line i only voice-2 syllables starting in [start_i, end_i) are shown. Sweep the distinct start times in order; the transitive time constraint only needs the previous event's column, and syllables starting together share the column, so the per-voice 'previous end + 1' bounds are combined with max. Pad with underscores up to the column, no trailing underscores, print '/' if voice 2 has nothing. O(total syllables). Pitfalls: syllables may contain any punctuation so tokenize by whitespace per line; voice 2 never wraps or repeats; the second voice may start mid-line so it gets leading underscores.
